strings.name: Quentin Tarantino
strings.summary: Tarantino moved from video-store work and self-directed film study into writing and directing. Reservoir Dogs and Pulp Fiction drew attention for dialogue, interwoven structures and genre references. He recombines crime, martial-arts, western and imagined-history films, winning two screenplay Oscars. His violence, racial language and rewriting of history have prompted continuing debate.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Works such as Pulp Fiction reshaped the language of genre cinema; his dialogue, structures and cinematic references influenced creators internationally.
